description: Get reels from public Facebook Pages. Returns one row per reel with plays, reactions, comments, shares, caption, date, length, and link.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_reels_per_page.description: Text number from 1 to 300. Default 20. Newest reels first.

pages.description: Public Page names or facebook.com addresses, for example natgeo or https://www.facebook.com/natgeo/reels/. Groups and personal profiles are not read. In Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

since_date.description: Optional date like 2026-01-31. Reading stops at the first reel older than this.

name: get_facebook_page_reels
title: Get Facebook Page reels
